entry.title: New: Resolution 612 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF TWENTY-SIX PORTABLE GENERATORS FROM THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE, HAWAIʻI EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY

The donation to the Civil Defense Agency, with an estimated value of $15,619.47, would be used to enhance the department’s local emergency capabilities.
